name: MoneyField
description:
MoneyInput bound to a `number | null` (minor units) form field. Pair it with `moneySchema()`.
A currency picker changes the field's amount in the new currency's units; keep the currency in
its own field with `currency` and `onCurrencyChange`.
signature: ({ label, hint, optional, required, aside, className, disabled, width, ...control }: MoneyFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: allowNegative
props.description: Allows values below zero when validation also permits them.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: currencies
props.description:
The currencies a person can choose from (ISO 4217, in this order). With two or more, a currency
picker sits at the start of the box, showing the chosen currency's symbol and code, and the
amount is shown without its symbol.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217. Default AUD. With `currencies`, pass it with `onCurrencyChange`, or use `defaultCurrency`.

props.name: currencyDisplay
props.description:
How the currency is shown: "narrowSymbol" ("$", default), "symbol" ("A$", the locale's
unambiguous symbol) or "code" ("AUD"). In the picker, the symbol comes before the code.

props.name: defaultCurrency
props.description: The first currency when `currency` is not controlled. Default AUD.

props.name: fractionDigits
props.description:
Hold amounts finer than the currency's minor unit (unit costs): the value counts
10^-fractionDigits of the currency (4: 525 is $0.0525), shown with 2 to `fractionDigits`
decimals for AUD. At least the currency's own decimals. Pair with
`moneySchema({ fractionDigits })`, and use the same scale for `min`, `max` and `step`.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale the number is shown and typed in (decimal and grouping marks). Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: min
props.description: Bounds in minor units. Default min 0 (no negatives) unless `allowNegative`.

props.name: onCurrencyChange
props.description:
Called with the currency a person chose. The amount stays the same in major units, rounded to
the new currency's decimals (12.50 AUD becomes 12.50 EUR, or 13 JPY), and `onValueChange`
reports it in the new currency's minor units in the same event.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: scrubLabel
props.description: A short prefix inside the box that scrubs the value when dragged ("W", "Max").

props.name: showCode
props.description: Show the currency code after the amount ("AUD"), for screens with more than one currency. Default false. Not needed with a picker.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: step
props.description: Step for the arrow keys, in minor units. Default one major unit ($1).

props.name: steppers
props.description: Show the − / + steppers (default). Arrow keys always step.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.
